build_rope_attention: build a RoPEAttention module with spatial-temporal rotary position encoding for video transformers
create_block_transformer: create a transformer Block with optional RoPE attention, MLP, and drop path regularization
create_cross_attention: create a CrossAttentionBlock that attends from query tokens to key-value tokens
create_mlp: create an MLP or SwiGLUFFN feedforward layer with configurable activation and dropout
create_lambda_warmup: create a Lambda_LinearWarmupHold scheduler that linearly warms up a learning rate parameter over iterations
